# Mono & Co.

> Digital marketing and design studio based in Islamabad, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide (UK, EU, US and Gulf hours). Founded and led by Aun, a creative developer.

## Services
- Graphic design: visual systems, social creatives and print
- Branding: logos, identities and brand guidelines
- Web design: modern layouts designed around the brand and its customers
- Development: fast, responsive websites and web apps (React, Node.js)
- Ads & campaigns: paid social and search campaigns
- Posters: event, product and campaign posters for print and social
